newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's PDVSA plans Latam expansion.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's PDVSA plans Latam expansion.

text.p: State oil company Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) intends to boost its presence in Latin America where demand is expected to rise sharply in the next decade, PDVSA president Luis Giusti said on Wednesday.

"South America is very neglected at the moment," he told a news conference, saying that only 5.0 percent of PDVSA's oil exports went to South America and 18 percent to Central America and the Caribbean.

"In the next ten years demand (in the region) is expected to increase 280 percent," he added, stressing that Venezuela, Latin America's biggest oil producer, would look for a bigger presence on Latin American markets.
He reiterated that PDVSA was studying a number of ventures in Brazil, Peru and Ecuador. He said PDVSA planned to market shortly in Ecuador its Deltaven oil products trademark.
